fact: The draft FY2026 national budget gives the Ministry of Post and Telecommunication US$3.74 million (US$2.14 million recurrent, US$1.6 million Government-funded investment), with Government-funded projects rising from US$250,000 in FY2025 to US$1.6 million, mainly the National Postal Address System at US$1.5 million.
title: Draft National Budget FY2026
publisher: Ministry of Finance and Development Planning
